framing: He Was Socrates lives where teamwork already happens — a Slack-mediated Socratic interlocutor where the macOS daemon answers via slash commands. The bot is a thin relay; inference still runs on the user's Mac, preserving NO-CLOUD.
target_persona: Two-Weeks-Team org members who think in #channels — bilingual (ko/en) hackathon collaborators who want to consult Socrates mid-thread without context-switching to a separate macOS app window.
primary_surface: Slack bot (slash commands /socrates + unfurl + App Home). Web dashboard is auxiliary — only for opt-in usage reports. Inference always traverses the local /socrates daemon on the user's Mac.
opus_4_7_capability: Native function calling in tight, low-latency dispatch — mode_classify routes the slash command, ask_back returns a 평어체 Socratic question, defer_to_human emits ⊘ with an escape-hatch link. Function-call discipline keeps the bot from drifting into chatbot mode.
mvp_scope: 4-day demo: one Slack workspace, one slash command (/socrates), two response paths (ask_back + defer_to_human), App Home tab with locale toggle and privacy disclosure. No auth, no DB, no analytics — relay-only.
one_liner_pitch: Socrates as a slash command — 평어체 questions in your team channel, abstention with an escape hatch, all inference on the user's Mac.
spec_alignment_notes: primary_surface override: spec listed Kaggle preview HTML as artifact A; this advocate reframes the demo surface as Slack-native per P08 charter. Tone-lock (단정한 평어체), defer_to_human mechanic, NO-CLOUD invariant, and 4-function dispatch are preserved verbatim. Korean limited to user prompts + bot replies; Slack chrome stays English. Inferred default: bot is relay-only — the actual model never runs in Slack's cloud.
